integrity: Analytic proof includes dimension-free lower bound, equality rigidity, Fourier positive-semidefinite upper construction, and exact all-pairs comparisons. Finite rational code is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Proven for unweighted even-rim wheels with 2m rim vertices and m>=7. No small-rim, odd-rim, weighted, or minimum-dimension claim. Originality is literature-qualified and not independently verified.
title: Sharp Hilbert distortion and alternating-simplex rigidity for even-rim wheels
